summary_md: **cv usk ([@cv_usk](https://x.com/cv_usk/status/2115743193350168923))** explains *Large Flow Language Models* ([arXiv 2610.28559](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.28559)), which converts pretrained autoregressive models into **Lafa**, a blockwise flow LM trained on under 30B tokens that reaches 2.54× AR throughput at 7B with comparable quality, using asynchronous per-token flow times and self-speculative decoding with the retained AR head as verifier.
relevance: Faster decoding approach that could benefit local inference.
